description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_nonuniform_1d/rules/central_D1_nonuniform_zero_grad_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (N bound to 8 at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the plain D(u,x) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior centered nonuniform first-derivative stencil aggregate over [2,7]; second-order one-sided nonuniform faces at i=1 and i=8), zero apply_expression_template nodes (the grid geometry template the observed xc applies to the 9-node edge array xe is fully inlined), zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, with the free-name geometry array xc surviving as index references and the x_nodes axis folded to size 9. A first derivative needs only the cell centers, so no control-width observed dxw is materialized. This exercises the grid's edge-array contract: a metaparameter-expression index-set size (N+1) and apply_expression_template inside an observed. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
